## Decision package (PO merge gate)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story | US-… |
| Revision (head SHA) | |
| Scope (ACs covered, domains touched) | |
| SA decision / ADR (if any) | |
| Independent Review verdict (Critical / Major / Minor / Info) | |
| Targeted tests (command → result) | |
| CI (Jenkins build link → result) | |
| Known risks / accepted Minor-Info debt | |
| Blockers | |
| **Recommended action** | APPROVE / REJECT / RETURN_FOR_REWORK |

Merge with **"Create a merge commit"** only (no squash, no rebase).
The Factory recommends; only the PO approves and merges.
